title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 1 · Cellar and cistern

sourceRecords.title: 8 · Cellar and cistern · area 1
read: Old stone steps lead below the manor. The air is cool, and dark water rests in a deep cistern. Barrels and worn flagstones crowd the cellar. A narrow door leads farther in.

The cistern and the stored goods make this a working space rather than a grand entrance. Watch where the floor leaves room to move between them. You can examine the water, check the visible doors, or establish a position before continuing farther below the manor.

brief: Cellar beneath Tresendar Manor. View from a FIVE-foot-wide entrance landing FIFTEEN feet above the floor, with TWO short flights of stone stairs descending. A second ordinary wooden door is beneath the stairs on the north wall. A rectangular cistern occupies the western part: clean cold water, masonry rim TWO feet above the floor, ten feet deep internally. Kegs and barrels line dressed stone walls. Bright practical oil lamps, flagstones. Empty room. Secret southwest door blends perfectly into masonry; submerged satchel invisible. No bucket crane, no arches invented between rooms.
